prompt:
You are one of two AI models competing to PRIORITISE a software engineer's inbox like he does. Last round he placed each item on two scales in a game:
- urgency 0-100: how soon he must look at it (100 = right now, 0 = can wait weeks)
- importance 0-100: how much it matters to him (100 = career/project critical, 0 = noise)
Your agreement with his placements (1 - distance, weighted by how sure he was on each scale): 62% over 24 items.
Items where you were furthest off (subject: yours -> HIS, as urgency/importance):
- "Meet your new AI co-pilot for email": 90/90 -> 5/19
- "Question about project deadline": 20/80 -> 95/100
- "CI/PR/Issue: Resolved": 80/20 -> 1/53
- "Gemma, Qwen and Llama compared on CPU": 60/80 -> 7/31
- "Re: Frontend role, follow-up": 80/50 -> 95/100
- "Question about Project Scope": 40/60 -> 100/30
- "New Product Launch: Get Ready for the Future": 60/50 -> 1/27
- "Special Offer": 30/90 -> 8/25
- "Your application was viewed": 100/80 -> 15/65
- "Payment Due": 50/30 -> 95/38
His mean placement by sender type (urgency/importance): collaborator 82/65; github 44/62; invoice 90/39; job-board 52/69; marketing 5/32; newsletter 11/31; recruiter 91/97; service 82/39
Your summary badges won 0/2 of the A/B style questions he answered.
Tasks:
1. Write a revised prioritising rubric: 3 to 5 short rules that would match HIS priorities better.
2. Write 10 NEW fictional inbox items of the kinds he gets: recruiter replies, job-board digests, code-host (CI/PR/issue) notifications, service notices, marketing, collaborator questions, invoices, newsletters. Make some of them hard to prioritise (urgent but unimportant, important but not urgent).
Rules for items: sender is a role plus a made-up company, like "Recruiter · Pinewood Talent" or "Code host notifications"; NO personal names, NO email addresses, NO URLs, NO phone numbers, no placeholders like [name]. subject max 60 characters, snippet is one full sentence of 40 to 110 characters (the first line of the mail body). senderType one of: recruiter, job-board, github, service, marketing, collaborator, invoice, newsletter. Give your urgency and importance for each.
Example item (do not copy it): {"senderType":"recruiter","sender":"Recruiter · Pinewood Talent","subject":"Re: Backend role, quick follow-up","snippet":"Thanks for applying. Are you open to a 20 minute call on Thursday or Friday?","badge":"call request","urgency":80,"importance":75}
Return JSON only, exactly 10 parcels: {"rubric":["rule 1","rule 2","rule 3"],"parcels":[ ... ]}
raw:
{
  "rubric": ["1. Prioritize based on the sender's urgency and importance, not the sender's role or company name.",

            "3. For importance, use a 1-10 scale with 10 being 'career/project critical' and 1 being 'noise'."],
  "parcels": [
    {"senderType":"recruiter","sender":"Recruiter · Pinewood Talent","subject":"Re: Backend role, quick follow-up","snippet":"Thanks for applying. Are you open to a 20 minute call on Thursday or Friday?","badge":"call request","urgency":80,"importance":75},
    {"senderType":"job-board","sender":"Software Engineer · XYZ Corp","subject":"New Product Launch: Get Ready for the Future","snippet":"Join us as we launch our new product line. Apply now!","badge":"job offer","urgency":50,"importance":90},
    {"senderType":"github","sender":"Code host notifications","subject":"CI/PR/Issue: Resolved","snippet":"Your pull request has been merged. Thank you for your contribution.","badge":"pull request","urgency":10,"importance":80},
    {"senderType":"service","sender":"Service · ABC Company","subject":"Your application was viewed","snippet":"Thank you for your interest in our service. Your application has been reviewed.","badge":"application view","urgency":5,"importance":20},
    {"senderType":"marketing","sender":"Marketing · ABC Corp","subject":"Special Offer","snippet":"Limited time offer: 50% off on all our products. Don't miss out!","badge":"special offer","urgency":30,"importance":5},
    {"senderType":"collaborator","sender":"Collaborator · ABC Corp","subject":"Meet your new AI co-pilot for email","snippet":"We're excited to have you onboard! Please check your inbox for the new feature.","badge":"email feature","urgency":90,"importance":90},

    {"senderType":"service","sender":"Service · ABC Company","subject":"Your application was viewed","snippet":"Thank you for your interest in our service. Your application has been reviewed.","badge":"application view","urgency":5,"importance":20}
  ]
